items.title: TAVI vs SAVR in low-risk AS: mortality higher with TAVI at 5-7 years (EACTS 2026)
items.summary: Time-dependent pooled analysis of PARTNER 3, Evolut Low Risk and NOTION (2,644 low-risk patients) found a nonsignificant early survival trend favouring TAVI that reversed over time, with significantly higher TAVI mortality at 5-7 years.
bullets: **Time-dependent meta-analysis** presented at **EACTS 2026**: **TAVI vs SAVR in low-surgical-risk** aortic stenosis.
Pooled **2,644 patients** from **PARTNER 3, Evolut Low Risk and NOTION**, each with ≥7 years of follow-up.
**All-cause mortality at 7 years**: **26.9% TAVI vs 23.7% SAVR**; absolute difference **3.2%** (NNT about 30-35 per the lead author), but **HR 1.14 was not significant** and the curves cross.
**49% of all TAVI deaths** occurred between **5 and 7 years**.
Result was **not significant** when **Evolut Low Risk** was removed (HR 1.39, 0.96-2.01).

Caveats: **conference data**, not peer reviewed. Commentators note **unequal loss to follow-up** and unknown cause of death. The lead author wants the heart team to weigh this, especially in **younger** patients.

items.title: FDA early alert: Edwards removes 4 lots of SAPIEN M3 TMVR delivery system after balloon bursts
items.summary: FDA flagged a potentially high-risk issue with Edwards' Commander M delivery system for SAPIEN M3 transseptal TMVR: three balloon bursts during inflation, with one death and one serious injury reported as of October 5.
bullets: **FDA CDRH Early Alert** (page current 15 Oct 2026): **Commander M delivery systems** used with **SAPIEN M3** transcatheter mitral valve replacement.
**Four lots** are affected: **67718561, 67804014, 67887043 and 67887044**. Other lots are **not** affected.
Edwards sent customers a letter on **5 Oct** advising them to **stop using, remove and return** the affected units.
Reason: **three reports** of the **delivery balloon bursting during inflation**.
Possible harm: **embolism** or **inability to retrieve** the device through the guide sheath, which may need surgery or other intervention.
As of **5 Oct**, Edwards reported **one death and one serious injury**.
Why risk is high: this population is **deemed unsuitable for surgery**. Report problems to **MedWatch**.
